entries.snippet: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

entries.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash

entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's plan to allow imports of Russian diesel appeared to falter this week after state and federal officials warned that handling any shipments could bring legal consequences and two tankers initially bound for the United States changed course.

entries.snippet: As Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and Republicans grapple with stunning losses, every remaining race matters. Some races are still too close to call, including Senate battles in both Alaska and Mississippi. Congressional correspondent Lisa Desjardins reports.

entries.snippet: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has signed off on the National Guard ramping up its presence in the nation's capital in military vehicles and boats as troops deepen their integration with local law enforcement.

entries.title: Paraguay prosecutor will seek charges against embattled president after bank collapse
entries.snippet: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña is under criminal investigation following the collapse of a major digital bank, prosecutors announced, hours after the South American leader's resignation and impeachment Thursday.

entries.snippet: Nobody may have suffered bigger losses Tuesday than President Donald Trump. But few others had more on the line than Musk, who gambled big and came up holding the midterm's worst return on investment.

entries.title: What happens when airlines receive bomb threats?
entries.snippet: Hundreds of airline passengers in Europe had their flights diverted or given military escorts this week after a series of bomb threats that officials have said were malicious hoaxes.

entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said he met with Vladimir Putin's envoy at the White House on Thursday but did not meet with Ukrainian officials who were also visiting.

entries.title: Trump signs proclamation he says will prevent future changes to Oval Office and Cabinet Room
entries.snippet: Since returning to the White House, Trump has overseen numerous design changes to various rooms, including the Oval Office, where he has filled the wall space with portraits, a copy of the Declaration of Independence and numerous golden accents.

entries.title: Key federal panel expected to approve Trump's arch amid court challenge
entries.snippet: The approval would clear a hurdle on the road to breaking ground on the project, and the administration has said it could launch construction within a day of the vote. But the proposed 250-foot tall gilded arch still faced legal challenges.

entries.title: Newsom says he will commute all 548 of California's death sentences to life without parole
entries.snippet: California Gov. Gavin Newsom said Thursday that he'll change all death sentences in the state to life in prison without the possibility of parole.

entries.title: Trump administration held talks with Iran on deporting Iranians during the war, court documents show
entries.snippet: The documents show that the administration maintained contacts with Iranian officials during the war over the removals, specifically for submitting travel documents and figuring out "possible avenues for removal."

entries.title: Austrian tycoon Rene Benko sentenced to 2 years in prison for fraud
entries.snippet: Austrian businessman Rene Benko, who suffered a major fall from grace after his real estate empire, Signa Holding, went bust, was handed two more years in prison.

entries.title: Gavin Newsom commutes sentences of all death row inmates in California
entries.snippet: Gavin Newsom, a Democrat and a rumored presidential candidate, moved to commute the death sentences of 548 inmates in California for one of his last acts as governor of the state.

entries.title: Americans voted against Trump's Iran war. Gulf countries hope that means an end to the conflict
entries.snippet: The US midterm results showed how unpopular Donald Trump's Iran war is. Now, Gulf countries, trapped for months in the middle of the war between the US and Iran, see reason for optimism.

entries.title: Pete Hegseth under fire as Republicans trade blame for midterm debacle
entries.snippet: Iran war hawk Pete Hegseth is facing the fallout from Republicans' midterms losses as high energy prices turned voters toward Democrats. US President Trump continues to support his embattled defense chief — for now.

entries.title: Does the Oleshky ceasefire signal progress to come in Ukraine?
entries.snippet: Hundreds of civilians were evacuated from the city of Oleshky after Russia and Ukraine agreed to a US-brokered ceasefire. Some observers have expressed optimism that more such humanitarian missions might follow.

entries.title: France: More than 600,000 protest as anger grows over cost of living
entries.snippet: Demonstrators took to the streets in several French cities to call for government action on the high cost of living. Protests were largely peaceful, but there were some reports of escalation, including in Paris.

entries.title: Arrests and investigations as Serbia begins post-election clean-up
entries.snippet: The landslide victory of the Students' List in Serbia's general election seems to have removed a blockage in the justice system: Cases that were long stalled are now suddenly moving forward.

entries.title: Germany’s Gen Z protests spark debate on integration, bias
entries.snippet: Political debate about the recent Gen Z riots have raised the question: Can Germany talk about problems with integration without putting entire groups of people under suspicion?

entries.title: Paraguay: President Pena resigns amid bank crisis
entries.snippet: Paraguay's President Santiago Pena has resigned amid a crisis over his ties to collapsed lender Ueno. Millions of customers' accounts are frozen, with public pension and health care funds also tied up.

entries.title: British comedian and actor Russell Brand found guilty of rape
entries.snippet: Prosecutors labeled Brand a sexual predator. He was charged in sexual assault cases spanning from 1999 to 2009.

entries.title: Iran signals satisfaction, skepticism after US midterm vote
entries.snippet: While the Iranian regime says the US midterms will not change Washington's policy toward Tehran, some officials and commentators see the resounding Democratic victory as blowback against the Iran war.

entries.title: Who is drug testing Russia's athletes, now that they have returned to international competition?
entries.snippet: DW has found that three-quarters of Russia's weightlifting team had no independent out-of-competition testing before this year's world championships, despite the country's doping history.

entries.title: EU court says CBD foods need approval for sale before they can be certified organic
entries.snippet: The EU's top court says CBD foods cannot be certified organic without approval for sale. The ruling concerns a cannabis compound whose use in food requires authorization, including before organic certification.

entries.title: What does Trump's midterm elections loss mean for strained US-India ties?
entries.snippet: Donald Trump's electoral setback might give New Delhi and Washington space to reset relations, but there is no guarantee that the US will actually change its approach to India.

entries.title: Pioneering Jewish academy opens in Germany
entries.snippet: A Jewish academy has opened its doors in Frankfurt. The Central Council of Jews in Germany, the country’s leading Jewish umbrella group, set up the project to combat hate and promote dialogue and learning nationally.

entries.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from international football
entries.snippet: The announcement by the footballing legend comes just weeks after a public spat with Portugal coach Jorge Jesus over playing time.

entries.title: North Korea tells EU to 'mind its own business' on human rights
entries.snippet: North Korea's UN mission has lashed out at the European Union over a draft UN resolution. Pyongyang has said the West does not have a monopoly on human rights.

entries.title: Poland arrests 4 accused of spying for Russia
entries.snippet: Poland has charged four people with espionage, saying they were sending information to Moscow. Two more have been accused of shipping military components to Russia.

entries.title: Finland court jails captain and crew member over Baltic cable sabotage
entries.snippet: Finland seized the Fitburg freighter last year over the suspected sabotage of cables linking Helsinki and Tallinn. It's one of several incidents of damaged infrastructure in the Baltic since Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
